Global DC OY is a plausible small Finnish data-center business, but nothing in this record confirms it operates, or at what capacity.

The evidence is a name and a tag. That combination is the strongest positive signal among the low-information European records reviewed, but it is a naming convention, not proof of a facility.

The record carries no megawatts, no operator, no website, and no confirmed business registration. The only source is an OpenStreetMap tagging review, and the research note states that search quota ran out before the entry could be checked against an operator site.
